import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class MCMF {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev, capacity, cost;
            Edge(int to, int rev, int capacity, int cost) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.capacity = capacity;
                this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        List<Edge>[] graph;
        int[] dist;
        int[] potential;
        int[] prevNode;
        int[] prevEdge;
        boolean[] inQueue;
        int n;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        public MCMF(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            graph = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            dist = new int[n];
            potential = new int[n];
            prevNode = new int[n];
            prevEdge = new int[n];
            inQueue = new boolean[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cost) {
            graph[from].add(new Edge(to, graph[to].size(), capacity, cost));
            graph[to].add(new Edge(from, graph[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost));
        }

        int[] minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            int cost = 0;
            Arrays.fill(potential, 0);
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                dist[s] = 0;
                Queue<Integer> queue = new LinkedList<>();
                queue.offer(s);
                inQueue[s] = true;

                while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = queue.poll();
                    inQueue[u] = false;
                    for (int i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = graph[u].get(i);
                        if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to] < dist[e.to]) {
                            dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to];
                            prevNode[e.to] = u;
                            prevEdge[e.to] = i;
                            if (!inQueue[e.to]) {
                                inQueue[e.to] = true;
                                queue.offer(e.to);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (dist[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) break;

                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (dist[i] < Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                        potential[i] += dist[i];
                    }
                }

                int addFlow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNode[v]) {
                    addFlow = Math.min(addFlow, graph[prevNode[v]].get(prevEdge[v]).capacity);
                }

                for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNode[v]) {
                    Edge e = graph[prevNode[v]].get(prevEdge[v]);
                    e.capacity -= addFlow;
                    graph[v].get(e.rev).capacity += addFlow;
                }

                flow += addFlow;
                cost += addFlow * potential[t];
            }
            return new int[]{flow, cost};
        }
    }

    static final int INF = 100000000;
    static final int NN = 6000;
    static int n, m, s, t;
    static int k, c, d;
    static int[] dist = new int[NN];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[NN];
    static int[] prex = new int[NN];
    static int[] prei = new int[NN];

    static int get(int x, int time) {
        return time * 52 - 52 + x;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        s = NN - 1;
        t = NN - 2;

        MCMF mcmf = new MCMF(NN);

        int kk = k;
        for (int i = 0; i < kk; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            mcmf.addEdge(s, get(x, 1), 1, 0);
        }

        k = kk;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();

            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                    mcmf.addEdge(get(x, j), get(y, j + 1), 1, d * (l + l - 1));
                }
            }

            int temp = x;
            x = y;
            y = temp;

            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                for (int l = 1; l <= k; l++) {
                    mcmf.addEdge(get(x, j), get(y, j + 1), 1, d * (l + l - 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                mcmf.addEdge(get(j, i), get(j, i + 1), INF, 0);
            }
            mcmf.addEdge(get(1, i), t, INF, c * (i - 1));
        }

        int[] result = mcmf.minCostMaxFlow(s, t);
        System.out.println(result[1]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
